name: 235. Keyless custom provider with a leftover disabled key (keyless residual key)
description: A custom provider created keyed, whose only key was disabled before it was switched to is_key_less, keeps that disabled key. Model discovery used to count enabled keys before asking whether the provider needs keys at all, so it logged 'no enabled keys configured' and never ran: the provider stayed at 0 models with no discovery status. Key DELETE was also refused on keyless providers, so the leftover key could never be removed. Red before the fix: 235.1 sees no provider-level discovery status after a refresh, and 235.2 gets 400 'Cannot delete keys on a keyless provider'. Green after: keyless discovery runs whatever keys are stored (the provider has no base_url, so the unauthenticated default OpenAI upstream answers 401 and the status is list_models_failed, which proves discovery ran without spending anything), and the leftover key deletes with 200. Every call is a management call or an unauthenticated list-models: no paid inference.
